data.name: Kamal
data.gender_notes: Kamal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kamal is a name that signifies perfection, completeness, and wholeness. It is often used to describe someone who has achieved spiritual enlightenment or has reached the highest level of moral character. The name Kamal carries the meaning “Perfection, Completeness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kamal usually hope their child will grow to embody perfection, completeness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Perfection in the eyes of God
data.etymology: Kamal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Perfection, Completeness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: كمال
in_arabic.meaning: الكمال اسم يطلق على المثالية والكمال في العرض والخلوة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الكمال في اللغة العربية يأتي من الجذر الكاف-ميم-لام، ويشير إلى المثالية والكمال في العرض والخلوة، وهو مصطلح يستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف الله تعالى، حيث يقال في سورة التوبة: "الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا يُدْخِلُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ حَدِيثَةً فِي الْجَنَّةِ« (التوبة، 21).

in_urdu.name: کمال
in_urdu.meaning: کمال کو پرفکتیوٹی اور کاملیت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: کمال کا اصطلاحی معنی ہے پرفکٹ اور کاملا ہونے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اس کا تعلق جڑ کاف-میم-لام سے ہے، جو قرآن میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، جیسا کہ سورة توبہ میں «الذین آمَنوا و اٹقوا ہم آؤں گے انہیں حدیثہ ہاں جنات میں« (توبہ، 21) کہا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कमल
in_hindi.meaning: कमल शब्द को संपूर्णता और पूर्णता के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: कमल शब्द का अर्थ है संपूर्ण और पूर्ण होना, यह जड़ काफ-मीम-लाम से संबंधित है, जो कुरान में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है, जैसा कि सूरह तौबा में कहा गया है "जिन लोगों ने विश्वास किया और डरे हुए, हम उन्हें जन्नत में एक नई जीवन शैली देंगे (तौबा, 21)।

in_english.name: Kamal
in_english.meaning: Kamal is a name that signifies perfection and completeness
in_english.long_meaning: Kamal is an Arabic name derived from the root Kaf-Mim-Lam, signifying perfection and completeness. It is mentioned in the Quran, as in Surah Tawbah, "We shall admit the fearing and righteous into a new life in Paradise (Tawbah, 21). The name has been used in Islamic tradition to signify the perfection of God. In modern times, the name is used across various Muslim cultures to signify perfection, completeness, and spiritual growth.
